name: Pinboard
verdict_reason: linkding installs in 25 minutes and runs on a potato. Pinboard costs $22 a YEAR. Five maintenance minutes a month already makes self-hosting the more expensive bookmark box.
what_you_lose: Pinboard's archival copies live on someone else's durable storage — yours live on the box you forgot to back up
A $22/yr bill that rounds to zero decision fatigue

what_broke: The stock image's uwsgi binds '::' and exits fatally on kernels booted with ipv6.disable=1 — our verification microVM is one, so this pair's compose boot is certified by the CI runner instead
Superuser env vars on first boot and you're in
